text_description: Fall ready-to-wear runway look on a model wearing an open, oversized dark forest-green glossy coated jacket with a structured collar, dropped straight shoulders, long loose sleeves, silver snap-like fastenings down the front, and visible tab/strap details near the shoulders and sleeve area; the jacket hangs over a cream, fuzzy-textured cropped bralette with a deep V neckline and soft triangular cups, exposing the midriff. Around the waist sits a deep plum-purple sculptural wrap or corset-like panel, fitted high and wide over the torso with curved folded shaping, an off-center front overlap, and small metallic snap details, with a sliver of the cream knit layer visible beneath it. The lower half is a matching plum-purple long narrow skirt with a smooth, slightly lustrous surface, sitting high at the waist and falling in a straight column beyond the frame, decorated along one side with a vertical line of small pale studs or beads; a soft purple pouch-like accessory or fabric appendage hangs at the left hip on a beaded/chain strap. Styling is completed with a short pearl necklace, bare upper chest, minimal visible makeup, and no visible footwear due to the crop, creating a layered contrast of glossy outerwear, fuzzy lingerie-like knit, and polished dark purple tailoring.
key_elements: oversized dark green glossy coated jacket worn open
deep plum sculptural corset-like waist wrap
side line of pale studs or beads on skirt
purple pouch-like hanging accessory at left hip
uncertainty_notes: Exact fabric contents are not visible; glossy surfaces only suggest coated or leather-like material.
Skirt hem length and footwear are not visible in the cropped image.
